answer: A trellis of signed attestations exposes correlated equivocation across k bonded identities; once proofs establish coordination, slashing grows as O(k²), rather than as k independent flat fines. Collateral held in the wharf escrow is depreciated asymmetrically: detection applies an exponential swarm multiplier, so shared control risks capital loss that rapidly exceeds the stake of isolated identities, leaving even an ember of recoverable value uncertain.
